# SAS

> SAS is a global leader in analytics and data management, delivering advanced solutions for fraud detection, risk management, and enterprise intelligence across industries.

SAS provides comprehensive analytics platforms including SAS Viya, serving customers across banking, retail, utilities, and public sector organizations. The company maintains a strong presence in the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) with offices in major cities including Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Vienna, and Zurich.

- [Charming Shoppes: Risk Management Analytics](http://www.sas.com/de_ch/customers/charming-shoppes.html): Customer success story demonstrating SAS Viya analytics and risk management.
- [St. Cloud: Fraud Detection Solutions](http://www.sas.com/de_ch/customers/stcloud.html): Customer case study highlighting SAS Viya fraud detection and analytics.
- [Project Odyssey: Machine Learning Implementation](http://www.sas.com/de_ch/customers/project-odyssey.html): Customer success story featuring SAS Viya machine learning and analytics.
- [Danish Prison & Probation: Risk Analytics](http://www.sas.com/de_ch/customers/danish-prison-probation.html): Customer case study demonstrating SAS Viya analytics and risk management.
